tasks.name: UI-03 | Scene Navigation Orchestrator — פתיחת מסכים, פאנלים ורכיבים במצב מדויק
quotedClauses: מסלולים: 1) ספר/קטע/פסוק עם highlight, 2) Inspector מפרש ספציפי עם source anchor, 3) Global search+query+filter+selected hit, 4) Settings route+control focus, 5) tab/sidebar/panel/popover, 6) Notes/Bookmark/History selection (draft no save), 7) Sefaria Embedded RN surface באמצעות bridge/epoch/ready במקום פתיחת UI שגוי.

tasks.name: UI-07 | QA: מטריצת כיסוי 3 Backends × מסכים × AppIntent/DeepLink, security, regression
quotedClauses: הכן בדיקות מבוססות inventory ותיעוד PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN לכל רכיב/מסך וכניסה (in-app, AppIntents/Shortcuts/Siri, Deep/Universal Links, AI/Guides) עבור Otzaria, Sefaria Legacy, Sefaria Embedded. מקרים: cold/warm start, background/foreground, multi-window, active/inactive backend, reading unit/book/chapter/verse/highlight, local/remote search index, selected hit ID, commentary/Inspector, notes draft/no-save, sidebar/tab/menu, Settings subsection/control, invalid/stale IDs, iOS 26/27, Hebrew RTL and VoiceOver, Hermes ready/reset/no transport, old WidgetDeepLink.

Security: public deep link cannot mutate persistent state; app-intent parameters cannot elevate scopes or inject view selector; privacy of user notes; schema/URL fuzz, cancellation, tight limits, observability (trace ID, UI ack evidence), no MainActor hang, memory and responsiveness.

tasks.name: [P1][UI-AUTOMATION] חיבור מקיף של מסכים, רכיבים ומצבי ממשק ל־App Intents + Deep/Universal Links + AI
quotedClauses: - Native and embedded UI: full coverage of Otzaria, Sefaria Legacy and Sefaria Embedded (Hermes/JS RPC and native RN surface). Distinguish backend route readiness and actual visible scene from successful API response. Suspended/cold app, multi-window, offline and backend switching must not silently open wrong content.

- Observability: trace ID shared with ActionCore; log route resolution, backend/generation, scene, readiness, navigation/element acknowledgement, failure, elapsed time; redact user text/tokens; no claim of success after merely enqueuing.
